summary.en: Check elements one by one and learn basic iteration.
summary.zh: 逐个比较元素，理解最基本的遍历。

summary.en: Preprocess cumulative sums for fast range queries.
summary.zh: 预处理累计和，快速回答区间查询。

summary.en: Find boundaries inside an ordered range.
summary.zh: 在有序区间中定位边界。

summary.en: Count how many times each value appears in one scan.
summary.zh: 一次扫描统计每个值出现的次数。

summary.en: Find a pair by storing values already seen.
summary.zh: 记录已见过的值，寻找满足目标和的一对元素。

summary.en: Exchange adjacent ranges as a building block.
summary.zh: 交换相邻区间，作为旋转等算法的基础。

title.zh: 11.3节 - 演示序列的"旋转"算法
title.en: Section 11.3 - Demonstration of Sequence Rotation Algorithm

summary.en: Understand rotation through range exchange.
summary.zh: 用区间交换理解序列旋转。

title.zh: 排列的循环分解与搬移

summary.en: From permutations in 11.1 to source-directed cycle transfers with rotate_cycle_from in 11.4.
summary.zh: 从 11.1 的排列分解到 11.4 的循环搬移，沿来源表执行 rotate_cycle_from。

title.zh: 反转：递归与内存自适应

summary.zh: 比较双向反转、前向递归反转和共享缓冲区的自适应反转。
summary.en: Compare bidirectional, forward recursive, and shared-buffer adaptive reversal.
Sort by comparing and swapping adjacent values.
summary.zh: 通过比较和交换相邻元素完成排序。

summary.en: Maintain a sorted prefix and insert each new key.
summary.zh: 维护有序前缀，把新元素插入正确位置。

summary.en: Repeatedly select the smallest remaining element.
summary.zh: 每轮选择未排序部分的最小元素。

summary.en: A stable divide-and-conquer sort built around merging.
summary.zh: 稳定的分治排序，适合理解递归合并。

summary.en: Sort in place by partitioning around a pivot.
summary.zh: 通过基准分区实现高效原地排序。

summary.en: Represent a nearly complete binary tree in an array.
summary.zh: 用数组表示近似完全二叉树。

summary.en: Find primes in batches and see space-for-time tradeoffs.
summary.zh: 批量筛出素数，理解空间换时间。

title.zh: 习题3.3 - 素数计数函数 (计算较慢，请耐心等待)

summary.en: Compare pi(n) with the approximation n/ln(n).
summary.zh: 观察 π(n) 与 n/ln(n) 的近似关系。

summary.en: Explore palindromic primes in different bases.
summary.zh: 探索不同进制下的回文素数。

title.zh: 5.1节 - 判断一个数是否为素数

summary.en: Use trial division to test primality.
summary.zh: 用试除法判断一个数是否为素数。

summary.en: Understand the basis of probabilistic primality tests.
summary.zh: 理解概率素性测试的基础。

summary.en: Generalize Fermat to coprime integers.
summary.zh: 把费马小定理推广到互素整数。

summary.en: Repeatedly reduce a GCD problem using remainders.
summary.zh: 用余数反复缩小 GCD 问题。

title.zh: 求余与求商：倍增和斐波那契
title.en: Remainders and quotients: doubling and Fibonacci

summary.zh: 从逐次减法到倍增与斐波那契求余；观察候选量、运算次数与商余共享。
summary.en: From repeated subtraction to doubling and Fibonacci remainder; follow candidates, counts, and shared quotient/remainder work.
Replace division with shifts and subtraction.
summary.zh: 用移位和减法替代除法。

title.zh: 12.3节和12.4节 - 贝祖定理与扩展GCD算法(含习题12.7）
title.en: Section 12.3 & 12.4 - Bézout's Identity & Extended GCD (Including Exercise 12.7)

summary.en: Compute Bezout coefficients and modular inverses.
summary.zh: 求出贝祖系数和模逆元。

title.zh: 习题12.1 - 对比用斯坦因算法和欧几里得算法计算GCD的性能
title.en: Exercise 12.1 - Performance Comparison of Stein and Euclidean GCD Algorithms

summary.en: Compare Euclidean and Stein GCD performance.
summary.zh: 比较欧几里得算法和斯坦因算法性能。

title.zh: 2.1—2.2节 - 埃及乘法：递归与迭代
title.en: Sections 2.1–2.2 - Egyptian Multiplication: Recursion and Iteration

summary.en: Replace repeated addition with doubling and selection.
summary.zh: 用倍增和选择替代重复加法。
保持折半与累积流程，更换对象和合并运算。
summary.en: Keep halving and accumulation while changing objects and the combining operation.

title.en: Exercise 7.1 - How Many Additions Does the Basic Fibonacci Algorithm Need? (Time Complexity: O(φⁿ))

summary.en: Observe exponential growth in naive recursion.
summary.zh: 观察朴素递归的指数增长。

title.zh: 7.7节 - 使用幂算法计算第n个斐波那契数（时间复杂度:O(log⁡n)）
title.en: Section 7.7 - Calculate nth Fibonacci Number Using Power Algorithm (Time Complexity: O(log n))

summary.en: Use matrix powers to compute Fibonacci in O(log n).
summary.zh: 用矩阵幂在 O(log n) 时间计算斐波那契数。

title.zh: 8.6节 - 找出有向图中任意两个节点之间的最短距离
title.en: Section 8.6 - Finding Shortest Distance Between Any Two Nodes in a Directed Graph

summary.en: Reuse matrix power over the tropical semiring.
summary.zh: 在热带半环上复用矩阵幂思想。

summary.en: Compare BFS queues and DFS stacks.
summary.zh: 比较 BFS 队列和 DFS 栈。

title.zh: 习题9.2 - π 的下界与上界
title.en: Exercise 9.2 - Lower and Upper Bounds for π

summary.en: Inscribed half-perimeters bound π below; circumscribed half-perimeters bound it above.
summary.zh: 内接半周长给出 π 的下界，外切半周长给出上界。

summary.en: Quickly screen large prime candidates probabilistically.
summary.zh: 用概率测试快速筛选大素数。

summary.en: Combine primes, GCD, inverses, and fast modular power.
summary.zh: 组合素数、GCD、模逆元和快速幂。

title.zh: 多项式带余除法与最大公约数

summary.zh: 在有理数系数多项式中逐步消元、求余，复用泛型GCD循环，最后首一化。
summary.en: Eliminate leading terms with exact rational coefficients, reuse the generic GCD loop, then make the result monic.

summary.zh: 比较逐项求值与嵌套累积，观察表达式、变量和运算次数。
summary.en: Compare direct evaluation with nested accumulation through expressions, variables, and operation counts.

summary.zh: 从集合与运算的例子理解结合律、单位元素和逆元。
summary.en: Explore associativity, identities, and inverses through sets and operations.

summary.zh: 从矩阵中的一个格子理解乘法，再用布尔运算研究图的可达性。
summary.en: Understand multiplication one matrix cell at a time, then explore graph reachability with Boolean operations.

summary.zh: 比较迭代器能力、移动代价和半开区间的尾后位置。
summary.en: Compare iterator capabilities, movement costs, and the past-the-end position of half-open ranges.
